name: Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 75 2025 (MiTV-MOEU0, ladybird, MediaTek)
warnings: Held volume: with HomeKeyService and InputKeyService bound and key_filter true, holding Volume Up or Down on the real remote stepped once per press (as on the MiTV-MOSR4, #944). key_filter false in config.xml brought the ramp back with both services still bound, at the cost of the Settings (176), YouTube (190) and TV+ (192) buttons, which then do nothing; their tiles and the Settings pill remain.

The list applied as is after a factory reset, in this order: the saved Wi-Fi network belonged to setupwraith again (first-run wizard), so it was forgotten and joined again first; setupwraith was disabled while launcherx was still enabled; then the installer took Home.
Do NOT re-enable setupwraith while launcherx is disabled, not even for a minute: on this unit Home resolved to setupwraith/.RecoveryActivity, and the reboot after it never finished.
Wi-Fi and ADB never came up, Android's "Cannot load Android system" rescue screen followed, "Try again" failed three times and only a factory reset brought the TV back.

Still running with Xiaomi's tracking SDK inside (api.ad.xiaomi.com, tracking.miui.com in the dex), and needed: mitv.service, com.mitv.livetv, com.mi.bluetooth, com.xiaomi.tvqs.overseas.y24 (see DO NOT DISABLE above).
